yt_title: GTA 6 Comes Out Tomorrow — But You Can Explore Calgary's Real Map Today (Free Game)
yt_desc:
GTA 6 comes out tomorrow. But what if your next open world is Calgary?

YYC City Stories is a free open-world game built on the real map of Calgary. It runs right in your web browser: no download, no account.

What's in it:
• Real streets from OpenStreetMap; buildings, parks and the shape of the ground mostly from City of Calgary open data
• Homes fitted to their real footprints and heights
• Landmarks like Historic City Hall, The Bow, TELUS Sky, the Saddledome and the Calgary Tower
• Stampede Park: a midway, the Grandstand Show, a country music stage and fireworks every night
• Take the stage at Stampede Park and perform while the lyrics play on the big screen
• Calgary Transit with real routes and stops: catch a bus or ride the CTrain on the Red and Blue lines
• Recent 311 service requests from the City's open data, shown in the community where they were reported
• Five characters and twenty-seven missions about how the city works
• English, French, Punjabi, Urdu, Tagalog and Arabic
• Free roam: cars, a helicopter, landmarks and online play
• Play online together: room for dozens of players at once, ride in a friend's car or helicopter, text and voice chat

▶ Play free: calgaryinsight.ca/game

Which Calgary spot should we add next? Tell us in the comments 👇

Music: "Under One Sky", the game's title song.
Not affiliated with Rockstar Games, the City of Calgary or the Calgary Stampede.

🔔 Subscribe and follow @calgaryinsight for more Calgary stories.
